results.title: Release build has no control channel
results.reason: C-HOOK-1 is defined for the agent-rs release binary. On ESP32 the channel is excluded at build time: the prod profile forces CONFIG_IRONMESH_DUT_CONTROL=n (checked by device/esp32/tools/check_prod_config.py in CI); the esp32-host shim and the hil profile are test builds by definition
